
---

# PWA / mobile progress (feat/pwa-mobile branch, 2026-09-09)

Scope: mobile UX + PWA install/offline/reconnect/notifications only. No changes to
conversation logic, harness, chat API, auth, or desktop layout beyond mounting the
PWA layer.

Implemented:

* `public/manifest.json` — full icon set (generated by `scripts/generate-icons.mjs`
  via sharp from `public/icons/icon.svg`), shortcuts, maskable + badge + apple-touch icons.
* `public/sw.js` — hand-written service worker: app-shell cache, runtime caching
  strategies, offline message queue (IndexedDB + Background Sync `chat-sync`),
  `QUEUE_MESSAGE` / `NOTIFY_COMPLETION` / `SKIP_WAITING` message handlers.
* `src/components/pwa/sw-registration.tsx` — SW registration, update-available banner
  (SKIP_WAITING + one-time controllerchange reload), install banner gated on engagement.
* `src/hooks/use-pwa-install.ts` — BeforeInstallPromptEvent capture, standalone
  detection via useSyncExternalStore, install()/dismiss().
* `src/hooks/use-online-status.ts` — shared external store over online/offline events.
* `src/components/pwa/offline-indicator.tsx` — offline banner + "Back online" toast.
* `src/components/pwa/notification-manager.tsx` — `useNotifications()`; completion
  notification via SW showNotification, only when the tab is hidden.
* `src/components/chat/chat.tsx` — additive wiring: offline submit queues to SW
  (IndexedDB fallback for iOS), onFinish triggers completion notification.
* `src/app/layout.tsx` — viewport/themeColor (Next 16 viewport export), manifest +
  apple meta tags in explicit head.
* `src/app/globals.css` — safe-area utilities (pt-safe etc.) + standalone padding.

Known limitations / integration notes:

* iOS Safari: no Background Sync — handled by client-side IndexedDB fallback; push
  requires iOS 16.4+ installed-to-home-screen (no push server configured yet).
* Notifications are completion-only while the tab is hidden; no push server (needs a
  VAPID key + subscription endpoint — out of this branch's scope).
* Pre-existing lint error in `src/hooks/use-mobile.ts:14` (setState-in-effect) is on
  main and untouched here — same pattern we removed from our hooks; worth fixing on main.
* Build requires DATABASE_URL (pre-existing Phase 2 requirement, unrelated to PWA).
